newsitem.title: LITHUANIA: Lithuanian shares down, outlook mixed.
newsitem.headline: Lithuanian shares down, outlook mixed.

text.p: The official list and group A indices closed down at Lithuania's stock exchange Tuesday, with only the lowly group B index posting any advance.
Official list shares eased 4.17 points to 874.57 points, and group A shares fell 22.55 points to 1884.46 points. Litin G advanced 6.48 points to 1688.58 points.
Turnover on the central market grew to 416,000 litas from 366,000 litas Monday, but was still low.
"There will be continued mixed trading throughout the week, with central market turnover staying at the same level, about 300,000 litas to 500,000 litas," said one dealer.
But another broker said that current prices are too low and that they will advance by two percent to five percent this week or next week.
Brokers say activity on the market will not increase significantly or lead to a continuous upward trend before the end of the summer, but they have found optimism in a few shares, like Hermis Bank.
Hermis shares traded at a steady 180.00 litas and turned over 146,000 litas on the central market.
Hermis rival Vilniaus Bank dropped to 222.00 litas from 224.00 litas, turning over 60,000 litas on the central market.
Brokers say Vilniaus Bank shares are becoming more attractive as they ease closer to 220.00 litas, which is seen by many as the bottom of its usual trading range.
